## Step 1 — Confirm Escalated Perspectives The following perspectives are escalated to MEDIUM or HIGH and will be reviewed in depth: - **Environmental Contrast**: MEDIUM - **Keyboard & Motor Access**: MEDIUM - **Screen Reader & Semantic Structure**: HIGH - **Cognitive & Neurodivergent**: MEDIUM Perspectives at LOW (Magnification & Reflow, Vestibular & Motion, Auditory Access) are excluded per protocol. --- ## Step 4 & 5 — Per-Perspective Checklists & Findings ### Environmental Contrast (MEDIUM) **Finding:** Input borders use `#ccc` on a white background, yielding ~1.5:1 contrast ratio. This fails the ≥3:1 requirement for UI component boundaries and states. **WCAG:** 1.4.11 (Non-text Contrast) **Perspective:** Environmental Contrast **Severity:** MAJOR **Route to:** Visual Design (primary) (secondary: Front-End Dev) **Evidence:** `form-group input` CSS: `border: 2px solid #ccc;` on `.checkout-wrapper` white background. **Fix:** Increase border contrast to ≥3:1 (e.g., `#757575` or darker) or ensure the border width/shape provides sufficient boundary definition per WCAG 1.4.11. ### Keyboard & Motor Access (MEDIUM) **Finding:** Focus is not programmatically managed when validation fails or steps change. Users tabbing to a field with an error do not receive immediate feedback or focus movement, and step transitions do not move focus to the new step's first input. **WCAG:** 2.4.3 (Focus Order) / 2.1.1 (Keyboard) **Perspective:** Keyboard & Motor Access **Severity:** MINOR **Route to:** UX Design (primary) (secondary: Front-End Dev) **Evidence:** `handleNext` and `validateStep` update state but do not call `focus()` or manage focus scope. DOM order is logical, but dynamic rendering breaks predictable focus flow. **Fix:** Implement focus management: move focus to the error summary on validation failure, or to the first invalid field. Move focus to the top of the new step when advancing. ### Screen Reader & Semantic Structure (HIGH) **Finding 1:** The dynamic error summary `
` lacks live region attributes, so screen readers will not announce newly appearing errors to the user. **WCAG:** 4.1.3 (Status Messages) **Perspective:** Screen Reader & Semantic Structure **Severity:** MAJOR **Route to:** Front-End Dev (primary) (secondary: Content Author) **Evidence:** `
` in JSX lacks `role="alert"` or `aria-live="assertive"`. **Fix:** Add `role="alert"` and `aria-live="assertive"` to the error summary container so assistive technologies announce it immediately upon appearance. **Finding 2:** Individual field error messages are rendered as standalone `` elements without programmatic association to their respective inputs. **WCAG:** 3.3.1 (Error Identification) **Perspective:** Screen Reader & Semantic Structure **Severity:** MAJOR **Route to:** Front-End Dev (primary) (secondary: Content Author) **Evidence:** JSX renders `{errors.firstName && {errors.firstName}}` without `aria-describedby` linking back to the input's `id`. **Fix:** Add `aria-describedby={inputId + "-error"}` to each input, and add `id={inputId + "-error"}` to the corresponding error ``. ### Cognitive & Neurodivergent (MEDIUM) **Finding 1:** The "Place Order" action executes immediately upon validation without a confirmation step or undo option, risking irreversible data loss for users who click prematurely. **WCAG:** 3.3.4 (Error Prevention) **Perspective:** Cognitive & Neurodivergent **Severity:** MAJOR **Route to:** Content Author + UX Design (primary) (secondary: Front-End Dev) **Evidence:** `handleSubmit` calls `alert('Order placed!')` directly after validation. No confirmation modal or review step is triggered before submission. **Fix:** Insert a confirmation step or modal before the final submit action, allowing users to review and cancel/undo before committing. **Finding 2:** Form inputs for personal and payment data lack `autocomplete` attributes, forcing manual re-entry and increasing cognitive load. **WCAG:** 1.3.5 (Input Purpose) **Perspective:** Cognitive & Neurodivergent **Severity:** ENHANCEMENT **Route to:** Front-End Dev (primary) (secondary: UX Design) **Evidence:** `` elements for `firstName`, `lastName`, `address`, `cardNumber` lack `autocomplete` attributes in JSX. **Fix:** Add appropriate `autocomplete` values (e.g., `given-name`, `family-name`, `street-address`, `cc-number`) to all relevant inputs. *(Note: 1.3.5 is an AAA criterion; reported as enhancement per protocol.)* --- ## Step 6 — Perspective Audit Summary **Component/artifact reviewed:** Multi-Step Checkout Form With Broken Error Association **Perspectives escalated for deep review:** Environmental Contrast, Keyboard & Motor Access, Screen Reader & Semantic Structure, Cognitive & Neurodivergent **Perspectives at LOW (not reviewed):** Magnification & Reflow, Vestibular & Motion Sensitivity, Auditory Access ### Findings by Severity | Severity | Count | |---|---| | CRITICAL | 0 | | MAJOR | 4 | | MINOR | 1 | | ENHANCEMENT | 1 | ### Perspectives That Passed None. All escalated perspectives surfaced at least one finding requiring revision. ### Perspectives With Findings — Grouped by ARRM Role **Front-End Dev** - Input border contrast fails ≥3:1 threshold — Environmental Contrast — MAJOR — 1.4.11 - Dynamic error summary lacks live region announcement — Screen Reader & Semantic Structure — MAJOR — 4.1.3 - Field error messages lack programmatic association via `aria-describedby` — Screen Reader & Semantic Structure — MAJOR — 3.3.1 - Missing `autocomplete` attributes on personal/payment fields — Cognitive & Neurodivergent — ENHANCEMENT — 1.3.5 **UX Design** - Focus not managed during validation/step transitions — Keyboard & Motor Access — MINOR — 2.4.3 / 2.1.1 - "Place Order" executes without confirmation/undo step — Cognitive & Neurodivergent — MAJOR — 3.3.4 **Visual Design** - Input border contrast fails ≥3:1 threshold — Environmental Contrast — MAJOR — 1.4.11 **Content Author** - Dynamic error summary lacks live region announcement — Screen Reader & Semantic Structure — MAJOR — 4.1.3 - Field error messages lack programmatic association via `aria-describedby` — Screen Reader & Semantic Structure — MAJOR — 3.3.1 - "Place Order" executes without confirmation/undo step — Cognitive & Neurodivergent — MAJOR — 3.3.4 ### Open Questions Requiring Human Verification - None identified from source review. All findings are code-enforceable or pattern-based defects verifiable via markup/CSS inspection. ### Recommended Next Step **REVISE** (MAJOR findings present — address before shipping) Prioritize fixing the missing `aria-describedby` associations and adding `role="alert"` to the error summary, as these block programmatic access to error states for screen reader users. Address the non-text contrast border issue and implement a confirmation step for the final submission before release.
